text:
Oliver: ACME legal asked for a POC runflow: hosted keys + optional Dedicated fallback + VPC peering checklist. Pilot start Wed.

Priya: I can draft. Is this a 2-week demo or longer? Affects key TTL and retention.

Marcus: Sales: 2-week demo, may extend. Need a monthly commit line for Dedicated in the SOW.

Priya: Draft defaults: scoped API keys TTL=14d, audit logs retention=90d, routing: hosted primary -> Dedicated preferred -> hosted fallback.

Nadia: Security pre-reqs: signed DPA, SOC2 summary, customer CIDR. HSM/KMS request needs escalation.

Sanjay: Infra can provision Dedicated in ~48h if capacity free. Send qps, model, avg/peak seq len, CIDR, and preferred region.

Oliver: Region preference: us-west1.

Priya: SE runflow (short): 1) create demo org & tag AE/SE 2) create scoped key (inference:invoke, embeddings:read) TTL 14d 3) provision pool (opt) + attach model 4) set smart routing 5) request or configure peering/IP allowlist 6) enable 90d logs & debug tracing 24h 7) run smoke tests 8) 7d check-in

Sanjay: CLI snippets:
redwoodctl pool create --name acme-demo-pool --gpu a100 --count 2 --region us-west1

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"org":"acme-demo","scopes":["inference:invoke","embeddings:read"],"ttl_seconds":1209600}'

Priya: Smoke test example:
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-4B","input":"smoke test","max_tokens":32}'

Marcus: Ballpark cost for 10k calls/day @50 tokens: Hosted ~ $45/day (with caching). Dedicated 2xA100 reserved ~ $8,000/mo fixed + vars. Will refine with finance.

Nadia: Send customer pre-req list: signed DPA, SOC2 pdf, CIDR, peering contact. Recommend audit retention 90d for demos.

Oliver: Owners: Priya (runbook), Sanjay (infra), Marcus (pricing), Nadia (security). Can someone provision Tue morning?

Sanjay: I can do Tue AM. I'll open RFC #infra-dedicated-request and tag infra on availability.

Priya: I'll publish the one-page checklist to CRM and attach to deal once numbers are in.

Ops-bot: Reminder: follow change freeze windows for infra changes. Tag release slot if needed.

Oliver: Thanks all. Priya, post final runbook and I'll add to the deal. Ping here if anything blocks.
